meihua.helpModal.title: 🌸 Meihua Divination Guide & Rules
meihua.helpModal.subtitle: Deterministic I-Ching Casting and Ti-Yong Decision Framework
meihua.helpModal.timeCastingDesc: The system automatically performs deterministic calculations using the current timestamp and earthly branches (year, month, day, hour). Built-in temporal anchor, no manual time input needed.
meihua.helpModal.randomCastingDesc: Clicking '🎲 Random Number Cast' generates 3 random seed numbers (1~999) corresponding to upper, lower trigrams, and moving line, capturing spontaneous insights.
meihua.helpModal.customNumbersDesc: You can also include 2 custom numbers (e.g. '6, 8') or 3 custom numbers in your prompt to cast.
meihua.helpModal.tiYongConcept: Ti (immobile trigram) represents the querent/subject; Yong (trigram with moving line) represents the external situation/environment.
